BL-1746 — Swarm stamp-off: hotfix a45dc5865d - remote_control_session_name_for_role in swarmforge.sh uses the swarm's config swarm_name as the Remote Control prefix when it is not the default 'primary', so a second swarm's coordinator (never a window line, so it could not name itself) no longer shows up as a second identical SwarmForge-Coordinator; a swarm with no swarm_name keeps its SwarmForge-* names; review-only, plus a probe of the two readers that still assume the SwarmForge- prefix
What it solves: ## What
An operator hotfix is live on main and has never been through a gate.
This is that gate: a REVIEW ticket. It confirms or refutes the hotfix and
opens narrow follow-ups for anything it finds.
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is asked. FIRM: review-only - the stamp never rewrites the hotfix. FIRM: the handler drives the launcher's real remote_control_session_name_for_role (and the display_name_for_role it calls), never a copy of…
BL-1746 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1746" (or "reject BL-1746 <reason>") to act.
